note: ORPHAN Pro 10:26 — like vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.

dims.v: exasperating sloth — the lazy man an irritation to those who rely on him
the sluggard who is, to those who send him on an errand, like vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes — the exasperating irritation of laziness that fails and frets all who depend on it
(those he is sent by, whom he irritates)
the sloth that grates on everyone who must rely on it

atsel (sluggard) — 'like vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes, so is the SLUGGARD to those who send him' (10:26); the lazy man is a stinging irritation to any who depend on him. Sloth does not merely fail; it exasperates.
